column1: # comment: Plan ⟂ execution de-conflation alignments to P-Plan, PROV-O, schema.org HowTo/Recipe, OPMW, and OBI. GMEOW models the distinction natively and bridges by reference (Principle 5).

column6: comment
BPMN sequenceFlow; GMEOW ControlFlow is a reified relator with optional guard.
P-Plan precededBy is a direct property between steps; GMEOW ControlFlow is a reified relator.
BPMN dataAssociation; GMEOW DataFlow is a reified relator carrying the flowing entity.
OBI planned process (OBI:0000011); GMEOW Execution is the event occurrence.
OPMW WorkflowExecution; GMEOW Execution is the execution side of the de-conflation.
P-Plan Activity is the execution of a Step; GMEOW Execution is the event that enacts a Procedure or Step.
PROV-O Activity; GMEOW Execution is the event occurrence that enacts a plan.
RO-Crate Workflow-Run CreateAction; GMEOW Execution is the event that enacts a procedure.
OBI protocol (OBI:0000272); GMEOW Procedure generalises this to all prescriptive specs.
OPMW WorkflowTemplate; GMEOW Procedure is the plan side of the de-conflation.
P-Plan Plan; GMEOW Procedure is broader (includes recipes, CI, business processes).
PROV-O Plan; GMEOW Procedure is typed as InformationObject and carries step structure.
schema.org HowTo; GMEOW Procedure is broader (includes protocols, CI, business processes).
schema.org Recipe is a Procedure of type recipe.
OPMW WorkflowTemplateProcess; GMEOW ProcedureStep is the atomic step in a plan.
P-Plan Step; GMEOW ProcedureStep adds stepType values and subprocess composition.
schema.org HowToStep; GMEOW ProcedureStep adds control-flow and data-flow relators.
schema.org step — the steps of a HowTo.
P-Plan Input variable; GMEOW stepInput is a property pointing to any entity.
PROV-O used — an activity consumes an entity; GMEOW stepInput is the plan-level consumption.
schema.org supply — a consumable input to a HowToStep.
schema.org tool — a tool used in a HowToStep.
P-Plan Output variable; GMEOW stepOutput is a property pointing to any entity.
PROV-O wasGeneratedBy — an entity is produced by an activity; GMEOW stepOutput is the plan-level production.
schema.org result — the output of a HowTo.
BPMN gateway; GMEOW stepTypeBranch is a value on a ProcedureStep.
